places.name: Gros Morne National Park
places.ai_summary: Gros Morne National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its dramatic landscapes, fjords, and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Western Brook Pond boat tour.
places.address: Gros Morne National Park, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Signal Hill National Historic Site
places.ai_summary: Signal Hill is a historic site offering panoramic views of St. John’s and the Atlantic Ocean, known for its role in communications history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Visit Cabot Tower for historical exhibits.
places.address: Signal Hill, St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Iceberg Alley
places.ai_summary: Iceberg Alley is a stretch of ocean where massive icebergs drift south from Greenland, offering spectacular views and photo opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed during iceberg season (April–July).

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a closer look.
places.address: Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site
places.ai_summary: L'Anse aux Meadows is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the only known Viking settlement in North America, featuring reconstructed Norse buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Explore the Norse ruins and visit the Viking settlement reconstructions.
places.address: L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Terra Nova National Park
places.ai_summary: Terra Nova National Park is known for its stunning coastal landscapes, forests, and diverse wildlife, offering various outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Try the coastal hiking trails and look for puffins.
places.address: Terra Nova National Park, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Cape Spear Lighthouse National Historic Site
places.ai_summary: Cape Spear Lighthouse is a historic lighthouse located at the easternmost point of North America, offering stunning ocean views.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Visit the lighthouse and enjoy the coastal views.
places.address: Cape Spear Lighthouse, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Witless Bay Ecological Reserve (Puffin Viewing)
places.ai_summary: Witless Bay Ecological Reserve is a protected area known for its large puffin colony and stunning coastal scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the puffin breeding season (April–August).

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour for the best puffin viewing experience.
places.address: Witless Bay Ecological Reserve, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.ai_summary: Bonavista Peninsula is known for its dramatic coastal cliffs, historic sites, and as a prime location for whale watching.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer for whale watching.

places.place_tip: Visit the Cape Bonavista Lighthouse and look for puffins and icebergs.

places.name: Fogo Island
places.ai_summary: Fogo Island is known for its stunning landscapes, unique culture, and as a great spot for iceberg and whale watching.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer.

places.place_tip: Explore the island's hiking trails and visit the Fogo Island Inn.
places.address: Fogo Island, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: The Rooms (St. John's)
places.ai_summary: The Rooms is a cultural facility in St. John's, housing the provincial museum, art gallery, and archives, with stunning views of the city and harbor.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Check out the local art exhibits and the view from the balcony.
places.address: The Rooms, St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Twillingate
places.ai_summary: Twillingate is a town known for its beautiful icebergs, whale watching, and as a gateway to the scenic Twillingate Islands.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer for iceberg and whale watching.

places.place_tip: Visit the Twillingate Museum and take a boat tour to see icebergs.
places.address: Twillingate, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: Torngat Mountains National Park
places.ai_summary: Torngat Mountains National Park is a remote and rugged park known for its stunning mountain scenery, glaciers, and wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Access is primarily by boat or air.

places.place_tip: Experience the stunning scenery and look for polar bears and caribou.
places.address: Torngat Mountains National Park, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.ai_summary: Red Bay is a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring the remains of a 16th-century Basque whaling station and a reconstructed whaling vessel.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Visit the whaling station and the interpretive center.
places.address: Red Bay, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.name: St. John's
places.ai_summary: St. John's is the capital city of Newfoundland and Labrador, known for its colorful row houses, vibrant arts scene, and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot.

places.place_tip: Visit Signal Hill and the historic downtown area.

places.name: East Coast Trail
places.ai_summary: The East Coast Trail is a long-distance coastal hiking trail offering stunning views, sea stacks, and opportunities to see icebergs and whales.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in summer and early fall.

places.place_tip: Start at Cape Spear and hike to St. John's for stunning views.

places.ai_summary: Battle Harbour is a historic site featuring a restored 19th-century fishing village and interpretive center, offering a glimpse into Newfoundland's fishing history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Explore the restored buildings and learn about the fishing industry.
places.address: Battle Harbour, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer for seabird watching.

places.place_tip: Visit the Cape St. Mary's Lighthouse and watch for puffins and other seabirds.

places.ai_summary: George Street is a famous street in St. John's known for its vibrant nightlife, historic buildings, and as a hub of local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best experienced in the evening.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the local music and try the seafood at nearby restaurants.
places.address: George Street, St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

places.ai_summary: The Signal Hill Tattoo is a military tattoo held at Signal Hill in St. John's, featuring music, dance, and military demonstrations.

opening_hours.notes: Seasonal event, check schedule for dates.

places.place_tip: Arrive early for the best viewing spots.

places.name: Quidi Vidi Village
places.ai_summary: Quidi Vidi is a picturesque fishing village in St. John's, known for its colorful houses, artisan shops, and the Quidi Vidi Brewery.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or early afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the Quidi Vidi Brewery and try the local craft beer.
